pixel_findings.scope: Local visible pulse/machine projectile head revision
pixel_findings.observation: The new head has a slimmer bright horizontal core and dark edge compared with the original more rounded gold flash. It is distinguishable at original resolution in these frame pairs and follows the same recorded projectile location.
pixel_findings.limits: Small detail change;not a whole-weapon makeover or proof of fast-action/small-screen readability.

pixel_findings.scope: Trajectory trail readability gain and contact accents
pixel_findings.observation: Blade artwork remains present and trail changes are restrained. New warm thin strokes merge with the already gold/cream architecture and horizon;I cannot consistently separate a new contact accent at the training-target edge in this selection.
pixel_findings.limits: No new gross screen-sized obstruction seen,but absence of obstruction is not proof of improved readable feedback. Need actual full-speed observation or a deliberate contrast/readability pass before claiming improvement.

pixel_findings.observation: Original beam line is already visible to the target. New endpoint ticks/core accent are too subtle against existing bright line and warm facade to establish an independently readable gain from these pairs.
pixel_findings.limits: Do not describe this as a completed laser redesign or improved endpoint communication;technical segment parity is separately established.

pixel_findings.scope: Preservation of baseline boomerang silhouette only
pixel_findings.observation: The existing rotating gold blade silhouette and its position remain visually consistent;no large replacement glow obscures the actor.
pixel_findings.limits: New boomerang impact/return visual improvements were not clearly demonstrated here;the original shared entity drawing remains dominant.

pixel_findings.observation: The original mine silhouette at the first training target remains visible. Additional attached-state short rays are difficult to distinguish reliably from the existing gold edge and nearby building details at native scale.
pixel_findings.limits: Cannot sign a clearer attached-state indicator merely because current code draws one. Training fixture is not an enemy-art acceptance case.

pixel_findings.scope: Presence of restrained broken blast arcs without additional opaque fill
pixel_findings.observation: Faint sparse gray/cream broken arc segments are visible inside the large original gold expansion ring,especially over the dark ground below it. Candidate does not introduce an additional filled flash or screen-wide glow.
pixel_findings.limits: Original large gold ring/center flash remains overwhelmingly dominant and already covers local scene details in both versions. This does not establish better blast timing,range comprehension or reduced baseline obstruction.

pixel_findings.observation: All sampled pairs retain the actual Home hero and unchanged movement candidate. Nine modes remain largely the existing palette/forms with small accents;the earlier hand/weapon body connection and run-art REWORK are unresolved.
pixel_findings.limits: Do not claim fifteen unique polished weapon presentations or complete action coverage. Full-speed animation,timing and user preferences not observed.
